reader.requirement: At --std 85 data-name-2 and data-name-3 of a RENAMES entry must each name an elementary item or a group of elementary items in the record the 66 entry belongs to, must not be the same data-name, and must not name another level-66 entry or a level-77, level-88 or level-01 entry; each such violation must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel >= 2002: from 2002 RegionClauseCandidates returns SubtreeCandidates(record) (storage-tree items of the record only); below 2002 it returns QualifiedCandidates over the whole scope and ResolveRedefinesPass.Run filters by IsWithinRegion (kb/Work PB5165)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at --std 85 the whole-scope candidate set includes the record's own level-66 aliases, so `66 Y RENAMES X.` with X a 66 of the same record compiles and runs; at --std 2023 the subtree candidate set excludes 66 entries and the same program is refused COBOL1655
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover a legal RENAMES and an operand that names nothing; the 66/77/88/01 operand refusals and the same-data-name refusal are not exercised

probes.printed: exit 0: [AB] (66 Y RENAMES X, X itself a 66 RENAMES A)
probes.expected: refusal: "A 66 level entry cannot rename another 66 level entry"

probes.printed: 66 Y RENAMES X THRU C refused COBOL2740 'the beginning of data-name-3 precedes the beginning of data-name-2'; 66 Z RENAMES A THRU X refused COBOL1655 'the record's leaves do not tile the alias's storage window'
probes.expected: refusal naming the 66 operand; refused, but for an unrelated reason

error COBOL1655: 'K' does not name an item of the record

legal: signed elementary item THRU group, a group alone, a fully qualified elementary item, a qualified operand in a second record; MOVE to the group alias writes the group

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR4  (║5.11.3 Syntax Rules║)  the text is in SR4

reader.notes: 77, 88, 01 and other-record operands are refused at --std 85, and A THRU A is refused by the window-order screen. The 1985 candidate arm added for PB5165 (whole-scope QualifiedCandidates, filtered by IsWithinRegion) admits a level-66 alias of the same record as data-name-2, because the alias is registered by name under its record and ScreenRenamesOperand asks only for level 1 or 77; the 66 leg of that screen relied on the 2002+ subtree walk never reaching an alias.
reader.at-2023: refused: error COBOL1655: 'Y' RENAMES X: 'X' does not name an item of the record (ISO §2023:13.18.45.3 SR4; §2023:8.4.2.1)
reader.repro: WORKING-STORAGE: 01 R. 05 A PIC X(2) VALUE "AB". 05 B PIC X(2) VALUE "CD". 66 X RENAMES A. 66 Y RENAMES X. PROCEDURE DIVISION: DISPLAY "[" Y "]" STOP RUN. (file r4a.cob, fixed form, --std 85)
reader.expected: §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR4: "A 66 level entry cannot rename another 66 level entry nor can it rename a 77, 88, or 01 level entry." A refusal.
reader.known_note: none (kb/Work PB5165 introduced the whole-scope 1985 arm for RENAMES operands; it does not mention level-66 operands)
